_comment: Database MCP configuration — PostgreSQL and SQLite.
_security: Always create a dedicated read-only database user for Claude.
SQL to create a read-only Postgres user:
GRANT CONNECT ON DATABASE dev_database TO claude_readonly;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO claude_readonly;
GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO claude_readonly;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO claude_readonly;
Never use the postgres superuser or application user credentials here.
Never point this config at a staging or production database.

postgres._comment: PostgreSQL connection. Replace host, port, and database name to match your dev environment.
postgres._readonly_user: claude_readonly — created with SELECT-only grants as shown in _security above.

env._comment_env: Set PGPASSWORD_READONLY in your shell profile or a .env file loaded before starting Claude. Do not hardcode the value here.

sqlite._comment: SQLite connection. Requires no credentials. Path must be an absolute path to the .db file.
sqlite._use_case: Local development databases, prototypes, and analytics files that do not contain PII.
